**Best move:** a6

**Main line:** a6 d5+ Kxd5 (White threatens the knight; Black's knight is trapped and will be captured, with White up material)

**Motif:** trappedPiece

**Coaching note (80 words):**
When your opponent brings a piece to an edge of the board—here the knight on b7—look for the opportunity to trap it there. Pushing your a-pawn to a6 leaves the knight with no escape. After Black's best try d5+ to create counterplay, you capture with Kxd5, winning both pawns while the knight hangs. The lesson: a piece on the rim can become a prisoner. Control flight squares with your pawns.
